content_sections.heading: NSPCL Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: Here is a quick summary of the NSPCL Recruitment 2026 notification for candidates who want the key facts at a glance: Register for Job Alerts NSPCL is a premier joint venture company of two Maharatnas - NTPC Limited and SAIL - with its business units at Bhilai, Durgapur and Rourkela, having a total installed capacity of 1119 MW. NSPCL supplies power to SAIL units, the Union Territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli, the Union Territory of Daman & Diu and Chhattisgarh State, and has also ventured into the renewable energy domain.

content_sections.heading: NSPCL Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: NSPCL has announced a total of 17 vacancies across six posts. The projected category-wise vacancy break-up is as follows: Note: SC/ST/PwBD candidates who have secured pass marks are also eligible to apply. Vacancies for PwBD candidates will be provided as per Government guidelines.

content_sections.heading: NSPCL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The upper age limit for all posts is 32 years as on the last date of online application. Age relaxation of 5 years is applicable for SC/ST candidates, 3 years for OBC candidates, and 10 years for PwBD candidates as per Government of India guidelines. Relaxation of age is also applicable to Ex-Servicemen as per Government guidelines. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility. Selected candidates can be posted across India at any of NSPCL's projects/stations, including Subsidiaries/JV companies of NSPCL. All posts are transferable at the sole discretion of the Management.

rows.qualification: Graduate with at least two years full-time Post Graduate Degree/Post Graduate Diploma/Post Graduate Program in management with specialisation in Human Resource/Industrial Relations/Personnel Management, or Masters in Social Work, or MHROD, or MBA with specialisation in HR from a recognised Indian University/Institute recognised by an appropriate statutory authority, with not less than 60% marks, as per respective university/institute norms. Computer knowledge is essential; a degree in law is desirable.
Bachelor's degree in Law (LLB or equivalent full-time degree) from a recognised Indian university/institute with a minimum of 60% marks.
B.E/B.Tech degree in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics with at least 60% marks from a recognised University/Institution.
B.E/B.Tech degree in Mechanical/Production with at least 60% marks from a recognised University/Institution.
B.E/B.Tech degree in Electronics/Control & Instrumentation/Instrumentation with at least 60% marks from a recognised University/Institution.
B.E/B.Tech degree in Information Technology/Computer Science/Electronics & Communication with at least 60% marks from a recognised University/Institution.

rows.experience_required: Minimum 2 years post-qualification in-line experience in an organisation of repute dealing with Human Resources, Personnel & Administration matters, preferably in areas such as establishment matters, policy advocacy, industrial relations, recruitment and promotion, manpower planning, performance appraisal systems, general administration, statutory compliance, or HR policies.

Minimum 2 years post-qualification in-line experience in an organisation of repute dealing with litigation handling, drafting and vetting contracts and legal documents, providing legal opinions, arbitration and dispute resolution, statutory and regulatory compliance, coordination with advocates and regulatory authorities, and advising on legal matters. Experience in the power, infrastructure, engineering, or manufacturing sector is desirable.

Minimum 2 years of post-qualification executive experience (including training period, if any) in the power sector (Coal, Gas, Lignite) in Operation/Maintenance/Commissioning/Erection/Engineering or a combination thereof in the relevant discipline in a power plant/power project.

Minimum 2 years of post-qualification executive experience (including training period, if any) in an organisation of repute, handling and managing IT infrastructure, systems and operations that may involve overseeing network security, software development, database management, and communication systems. Certified Network Engineer with CCNA/CCNP or equivalent valid certification is preferable.

content_sections.heading: NSPCL Recruitment 2026: Reservations, Relaxations & Concessions
content_sections.text: Reservations, relaxations, and concessions for SC/ST/OBC (non-creamy layer)/XSM/PwBD candidates will be provided as per Government orders. Candidates claiming to belong to any particular category shall necessarily have a valid EWS/SC/ST/Disability certificate/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate, as the case may be, from the competent authority in the latest prescribed format of the Government of India. Category once filled in the online application form will not be changed and no benefit of other category will be admissible later on. Where there is a vacancy identified for such category, upper age limit is relaxed by 5 years for SC/ST candidates, 3 years for OBC candidates, and 10 years for PwBD candidates. Relaxation of age to Ex-Servicemen will be as per Government guidelines.

content_sections.heading: NSPCL Recruitment 2026: Service Agreement Bond & Health
content_sections.text: Selected candidates belonging to the General category will be required to execute a service agreement bond of Rs. 5,00,000/-. Candidates belonging to SC, ST, PwBD categories will need to execute a bond of Rs. 2,50,000/-, to serve NSPCL for at least 4 years after joining the company. Candidates should have sound health. Before joining, candidates will have to undergo medical examination at any NSPCL-notified/empanelled hospital, and the decision of NSPCL will be final and binding. No relaxation in health standards is allowed. Detailed health norms are available on the NSPCL website.

faq.question: Q1. What is NSPCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NSPCL Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive by NTPC SAIL Power Company Limited (Advertisement No. 01/2026) to fill 17 vacancies for Sr. Assistant Officer (HR), Sr. Assistant Officer (Law), Sr. Assistant Engineer (Electrical), Sr. Assistant Engineer (Mechanical), Sr. Assistant Engineer (C&I), and Sr. Assistant Engineer (IT/ERP) posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NSPCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 17 vacancies are available across six posts: Sr. Assistant Officer (HR) - 4, Sr. Assistant Officer (Law) - 1, Sr. Assistant Engineer (Electrical) - 4, Sr. Assistant Engineer (Mechanical) - 4, Sr. Assistant Engineer (C&I) - 2, and Sr. Assistant Engineer (IT/ERP) - 2.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NSPCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online application is 22 September 2026 (till 6:00 PM). Online applications commence from 7 September 2026 (10:00 AM).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for NSPCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post — a relevant postgraduate management degree/MBA (HR) for Sr. Assistant Officer (HR), an LLB degree for Sr. Assistant Officer (Law), and a B.E/B.Tech degree in the relevant engineering discipline with at least 60% marks for the Sr. Assistant Engineer posts, along with the specified post-qualification experience for each post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NSPCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 32 years as on the last date of online application, with age relaxation applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates as per Government guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for NSPCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: General category candidates need to pay a non-refundable registration fee of Rs. 300/-. SC/ST/PwBD/XSM candidates and female candidates are exempted from paying the fee.
